text: The Cullens have entered the cafeteria. Beautiful, mysterious, entirely uninterested in lunch. Bella has spotted Edward, and the weather forecast now includes a 100% chance of yearning. Twilight complete. You survived biology, vampire baseball, and the least relaxing trip to a ballet studio imaginable. One film down. The rain has stopped being weather. It is a lifestyle. Welcome to brunch. The Cullens may run on animal blood and unresolved feelings, but you need actual food. Fill your plate. Five films of extremely poor communication await. Every scene witnessed, 20 moments from the cafeteria to the snow field. You noticed the details. You stayed for the drama. Your Twi-hard badge is unlocked. At this point, you could probably give the Cullens a tour. A new heartbeat enters the Cullen house. Renesmee is born, and Edward fights to keep Bella from slipping away. You witnessed the moment everything changes. Love, terror, and a second chance at forever
